217	## 7. Conventions
218	- TypeScript strict everywhere. No external network calls at runtime from browser.
219	- Shared types: `server/src/shared/protocol.ts` is the source of truth for WS + run events; web imports a copy
220	  (`web/src/shared/protocol.ts`, kept identical).
221	- Ports/hosts via env. Logs JSON to stdout.
222	- Don't commit secrets. `.env.example` documents vars.
223	# claudebox v2 protocol (Nxeon fork)
224	
225	This document describes the `/v2/*` API that the Nxeon `app` uses to drive Claude Code inside
226	the `claudebox` container. The original `/prompt`, `/health` and `/v1/*` (OpenAI compat) endpoints
227	are unchanged.
228	
229	Verified against **Claude Code 2.1.287** (`claude --help`, real `claude -p` output and the
230	`sdk-tools.d.ts` shipped in the npm package).
231	
232	## Authentication
233	
234	Every `/v2/*` request needs `Authorization: Bearer $CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY`.
235	If `CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY` is unset, `/v2/*` returns 401 for everything (fail closed) unless
236	`CLAUDEBOX_ALLOW_NO_AUTH=1`. `/health` is unauthenticated.
237	
238	## Endpoints
239	
240	| Method | Path | Description |
241	|---|---|---|
242	| GET  | `/health` | `{status, activeRequests, version, claudeVersion, authMode, activeRuns, queuedRuns, maxConcurrent, firewallMode, autoPermissionMode}`. `authMode` is `oauth` \| `api_key` \| `credentials` \| `none`. |
243	| POST | `/v2/run` | Start a run; the response **is** the SSE stream (see below). |
244	| GET  | `/v2/run/:runId/events?fromSeq=N` | SSE: replay buffered events with `seq >= N` (inclusive, default 1), then follow live. Also honours the standard `Last-Event-ID` header (resumes at `id+1`) when `fromSeq` is absent. Ends immediately after replay if the run is finished. 404 if the run is unknown/expired. |
245	| GET  | `/v2/run/:runId` (alias `/v2/runs/:runId`) | Run info JSON (see `GET /v2/runs`). |
246	| POST | `/v2/abort` | `{runId}` → kills the run's whole process group (SIGTERM, SIGKILL after 4 s). Queued runs are just dequeued. → `{ok, runId, found, status}` (`status: "aborting"` for a running run). 404 if unknown. |
247	| GET  | `/v2/runs` | `{runs:[RunInfo], running, queued, retained, maxConcurrent}` — active (queued + running) runs. `?all=1` includes finished runs still retained. |
248	| POST | `/v2/preview/start` | `{projectSlug, port, command?}` → PreviewStatus (200) / 400 / 409 (port busy) / 422 (cannot detect a command). |
249	| POST | `/v2/preview/stop` | `{projectSlug, port?}` → `{stopped, ...PreviewStatus}`. Also kills any *unmanaged* process listening on the port (e.g. a dev server Claude started via Bash), except running Claude runs. |
250	| GET  | `/v2/preview/status?projectSlug=&port=` | PreviewStatus. `port` optional (defaults to the managed port). |
251	| GET  | `/v2/previews` | `{previews:[PreviewStatus]}` |
252	
253	`RunInfo = {runId, projectSlug, status: queued|running|done|error|aborted, mode, model, sessionId, pid, createdAt, startedAt, endedAt, exitCode, lastSeq, firstSeq, subscribers}` (times are epoch ms).
254	
255	`PreviewStatus = {projectSlug, running, managed, listening, port, pid, kind: "process"|"static"|null, command, startedAt, exitCode, logTail: string[] (≤200 lines)}`.
256	`running = managed || listening` — `listening` comes from a TCP connect probe to `127.0.0.1:<port>` (and `::1`),
257	so a server Claude started itself is reported as running (with `managed: false`).
258	
259	Errors are JSON `{error: "message"}` with an appropriate status.
260	
261	### POST /v2/run body
262	
263	```json
264	{
265	  "runId": "uuid (optional; generated if absent)  ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$",
266	  "prompt": "string",
267	  "projectSlug": "my-app",              // ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$ ; cwd = $PROJECTS_DIR/<slug> (created if missing)
268	  "sessionId": "claude session id | null",   // → --resume
269	  "model": "opus|sonnet|haiku|<full id>",    // → --model
270	  "mode": "auto|edit|plan|ask",              // default auto
271	  "thinking": "off|normal|max",              // → env MAX_THINKING_TOKENS 0 / 8000 / 32000 (unset = CLI default)
272	  "effort": "low|medium|high|xhigh|max",     // optional → --effort
273	  "attachments": ["/workspace/uploads/<id>/<file>"],
274	  "appendSystemPrompt": "string",            // → --append-system-prompt
275	  "maxTurns": 50,                            // → --max-turns
276	  "previewPort": 4123,                       // 4100-4199 → env PORT/HOST/BASE_PATH for Claude's shell
277	  "authToken": "optional per-run token",
278	  "autocompactTokens": 80000,                // optional; 0/absent = CLI default ("auto"). See below.
279	  "agents": {"code-reviewer": {"description": "…", "prompt": "…", "tools": ["Read","Grep"], "model": "sonnet"}},
280	  "agent": "code-reviewer"                   // optional lead agent (must be a key of `agents` when given)
281	}
282	```
283	
284	* `autocompactTokens` is the context size (tokens) at which auto-compaction fires. The CLI's
285	  `--autocompact` takes a *window* (100k–1M) and compacts at `window − 13k`, so claudebox passes
286	  `--autocompact <tokens+13000>`; below 87k it passes `--autocompact 100000` plus
287	  `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=<tokens/1000>` (percent of the 100k window → threshold = tokens).
288	  The model's own context window still caps it. Valid: 0 or 10 000–987 000.
289	* `agents` → `--agents <json>` (custom subagents; keys `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$`, value
290	  `{description, prompt, tools?: string[] (omit = inherit all), model?: alias|full id|"inherit"}`).
291	  JSON larger than 32 KiB is written to a temp file (`--agents <path>`, allowed with `-p`) that is
292	  deleted when the run ends. In `edit` mode the `Agent` tool is added to `--allowedTools` when agents are passed.
293	* `agent` → `--agent <name>`: runs the main session *as* that agent (its prompt/tools/model).
294	* `--forward-subagent-text` is always passed when the CLI supports it (`FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT=0` disables):
295	  subagent text/thinking is forwarded as `text`/`thinking` events **tagged with `parentId`** (never merged
296	  into the main answer, no `block_end`).
297	* Manual compaction: send the prompt `/compact [instructions]` with `sessionId` (→ `--resume`).
298	
299	* Attachments must resolve inside `$UPLOADS_DIR` or the project dir; each is appended to the
300	  prompt as `[Attached file: <path> — use Read tool]`. `--add-dir $UPLOADS_DIR` is always passed so
301	  Read works in every mode.
302	* `authToken` overrides the container env for that run: tokens starting with `sk-ant-api` are set
303	  as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` removed); anything else (e.g. `sk-ant-oat01-…`
304	  from `claude setup-token`) is set as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` removed).
305	* Child env: `CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY` and the server's `PORT` are removed. With `previewPort`:
306	  `PORT=<previewPort> HOST=0.0.0.0 BASE_PATH=/preview/<slug>/ NXEON_PREVIEW_PORT=<port>`.
307	  Always: `NXEON_PROJECT_SLUG`, `NXEON_RUN_ID`.
308	* Errors: 400 validation, 401 auth, 409 duplicate `runId` (use the events endpoint to reattach).
309	* Concurrency: at most `MAX_CONCURRENT` (default 4) runs execute; further runs wait silently in a
310	  FIFO queue (the SSE stream is open but emits nothing until the run starts; status `queued`).
311	* **Client disconnect never kills a run.** Only `/v2/abort` does. Reattach with
312	  `GET /v2/run/:runId/events?fromSeq=<lastSeenSeq+1>`. Event buffers (≤50 000 events per run) are kept
313	  for 30 minutes after completion (`RUN_RETENTION_MS`).
314	
315	## CLI invocation
316	
317	```
318	claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-partial-messages \
319	       --permission-prompts none \
320	       [--model M] [--resume SID] [--max-turns N] [--effort E] [--append-system-prompt S] \
321	       --add-dir $UPLOADS_DIR [--autocompact W] [--agents JSON|FILE] [--agent NAME] [--forward-subagent-text] \
322	       <mode flags>  -- "<prompt>"
323	```
324	
325	`stdin` is `/dev/null`; the child is spawned `detached` (own process group = pid) so abort can
326	kill the whole tree. `--permission-prompts none` (auto-deny anything that would prompt) is only passed when
327	the installed CLI advertises it in `--help` (feature detection at startup).
328	
329	### Mode mapping (verified against `claude --help` of 2.1.287)
330	
331	| mode | flags | notes |
332	|---|---|---|
333	| `auto` | `--permission-mode bypassPermissions` | Full tools. CLI 2.1.287 *does* have a `--permission-mode auto` (classifier-based), but it is gated per plan/model ("auto mode is unavailable for your plan/model") and can block actions when the classifier has no verdict — not reliable headless. Set `AUTO_PERMISSION_MODE=auto` to opt in. |
334	| `edit` | `--permission-mode acceptEdits --allowedTools Read Edit Write Glob Grep Bash WebFetch WebSearch TodoWrite NotebookEdit TaskCreate TaskUpdate TaskGet TaskList [Agent]` | `Agent` only when custom `agents` are passed. Anything else (e.g. MCP) is auto-denied. |
335	| `plan` | `--permission-mode plan` | Read-only exploration. The plan arrives as an `ExitPlanMode` `tool_use` (`input.plan`); its approval is auto-denied, so the run then ends. |
336	| `ask` | `--permission-mode dontAsk --tools Read,Glob,Grep,WebFetch,WebSearch,TodoWrite,TaskCreate,TaskUpdate,TaskGet,TaskList --allowedTools <same>` | `--tools` removes Bash/Edit/Write from the model entirely; `dontAsk` denies anything not pre-approved. |
337	
338	Thinking: `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS` = `0` (off) / `8000` (normal) / `32000` (max). On adaptive-thinking
339	models the CLI treats `0` as "thinking off"; non-zero values act as a budget.
340	
341	Note: Claude Code ≥ 2.1 in `-p` mode uses **TaskCreate / TaskUpdate / TaskList** instead of TodoWrite.
342	Both are mapped to `todo` events.
343	
344	## SSE format
345	
346	```
347	id: <seq>
348	event: <type>
349	data: <json>
350	
351	```
352	
353	* `seq` starts at 1 per run and increases by 1; it is only in the `id:` line (not inside `data`).
354	* First frame is `retry: 2000`. Heartbeat comments (`: ping <ts>`) every 15 s.
355	* Response headers: `Content-Type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8`, `X-Run-Id`, `X-Run-Status`,
356	  `X-Accel-Buffering: no`.
357	* The stream is closed by the server right after `done`.
358	* `done` is **always** the last event of a run (also for spawn failures, crashes and aborts).
359	
360	### Normalized events (see `server/src/shared/protocol.ts`)
361	
362	Extra fields beyond the protocol are additive and may be ignored.
363	
364	| type | data |
365	|---|---|
366	| `init` | `{sessionId, model, tools[], cwd, permissionMode, claudeCodeVersion}` |
367	| `thinking` | `{delta, parentId?}` — `parentId` = forwarded subagent thinking (full block, no `block_end`) |
368	| `text` | `{delta, parentId?}` — `parentId` = forwarded subagent text (full block, no `block_end`) |
369	| `block_end` | `{kind: "thinking"\|"text"}` |
370	| `tool_use` | `{id, name, input, parentId?}` |
371	| `tool_result` | `{id, isError, content, parentId?}` — content stringified, truncated to 20 KiB (`…[truncated N bytes]`) |
372	| `todo` | `{todos:[{content, status, activeForm?, id?}]}` — full list each time |
373	| `usage` | `{inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, parentId?, contextTokens?, estimated?}` — **incremental**; sum them for totals (incl. subagent `parentId` usage — `result.usage` excludes subagents). `contextTokens` (main thread only, absolute) = that message's input + cache read + cache write = current context size. `estimated: true` = synthetic usage for a compaction (the CLI reports 0 for it): `cacheReadTokens = preTokens`, `outputTokens = postTokens`. |
374	| `compact` | `{trigger: "manual"\|"auto", preTokens, postTokens, durationMs}` — context was compacted (manual `/compact` or auto mid-run). After it, context ≈ `postTokens`. |
375	| `rate_limit` | raw `rate_limit_info` (`{status, resetsAt, rateLimitType, isUsingOverage, …}`) |
376	| `result` | `{sessionId, isError, result, durationMs, numTurns, costUsd, usage:{…totals}, subtype, terminalReason?, permissionDenials?}` |
377	| `error` | `{message, code}` — code e.g. `authentication_failed`, `error_max_turns`, `process_exit`, `spawn_error` |
378	| `done` | `{exitCode, aborted?, signal?}` |
379	
380	### Raw → normalized mapping
381	
382	| raw CLI line | normalized |
383	|---|---|
384	| `{"type":"system","subtype":"init",session_id,model,tools,cwd,…}` | `init` (first only) |
385	| `{"type":"system","subtype":"compact_boundary",compact_metadata:{trigger,pre_tokens,post_tokens,duration_ms}}` | `compact` + estimated `usage`; the following `user` messages (compaction summary, `<local-command-stdout>Compacted`) are suppressed until the next assistant message |
386	| `system` subtypes `status`, `hook_*`, `task_*`, … | dropped |
387	| `stream_event` `message_start` (main thread) | remembers `message.id` as *streamed*, starts usage accumulation |
388	| `stream_event` `content_block_start` (thinking/text) | opens block (initial text, if any, emitted as delta) |
389	| `stream_event` `content_block_delta` `thinking_delta` | `thinking {delta}` |
390	| `stream_event` `content_block_delta` `text_delta` | `text {delta}` |
391	| `stream_event` `content_block_delta` `input_json_delta` / `signature_delta` | dropped (tool input taken from the full assistant message) |
392	| `stream_event` `content_block_stop` of a thinking/text block | `block_end {kind}` |
393	| `stream_event` `message_delta` | merges `usage` (final `output_tokens`) |
394	| `stream_event` `message_stop` | `usage` for that message (delta vs. anything already emitted) |
395	| `stream_event` with `parent_tool_use_id` (subagent) / `ping` | dropped |
396	| `assistant` (CLI emits one per content block, same `message.id`) — `text`/`thinking` blocks | dropped if the message was streamed (dedupe); otherwise `text`/`thinking` + `block_end`. Subagent (`parent_tool_use_id`) text/thinking → `text`/`thinking` with `parentId` (never main text). |
397	| `assistant` `tool_use` block | `tool_use` once per id (+`parentId` for subagents); `TodoWrite` also → `todo` |
398	| `assistant` with `error`/`is_api_error_message` (e.g. `authentication_failed`, "Not logged in") | `error {message, code}` (no text) |
399	| `assistant` usage (non-streamed messages incl. subagents, not `<synthetic>`) | `usage` (deduped per message id) |
400	| `user` with `parent_tool_use_id` and text content (forwarded subagent prompt) | dropped |
401	| `user` `tool_result` blocks | `tool_result`; TaskCreate/TaskUpdate/TaskList results (via `tool_use_result`) → `todo` |
402	| `rate_limit_event` | `rate_limit` |
403	| `result` | `result`; if `is_error` and no `error` was emitted yet → `error` |
404	| non-JSON / other types (`keep_alive`, `prompt_suggestion`, …) | dropped |
405	| process exit without `result` | `error {code:"process_exit", message: stderr tail}` |
406	| process exit | `done {exitCode}` |
407	
408	Example (real unauthenticated run): `init` → `error{code:"authentication_failed", message:"Not logged in · Please run /login"}` → `result{isError:true}` → `done{exitCode:1}`.

410	## Preview manager
411	
412	* One preview per project. Starting again restarts it. Ports `PREVIEW_PORT_MIN..MAX` (4100-4199).
413	* Spawned as `bash -c <command>` in its own process group, cwd = project dir, env:
414	  `PORT`, `HOST=0.0.0.0`, `BASE_PATH=/preview/<slug>/`, `BROWSER=none`,
415	  `__VITE_ADDITIONAL_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS=$PREVIEW_ALLOWED_HOST` (default `claudebox`). Auth tokens
416	  and `CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY` are stripped. stdout+stderr → 200-line tail.
417	* Auto-detect (when `command` is omitted); `npm install && ` is prefixed when `node_modules` is missing:
418	  1. `package.json` `scripts.dev` + vite → `npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT --strictPort --base /preview/<slug>/`
419	  2. `scripts.dev` + next → `npx next dev -p $PORT -H 0.0.0.0` (app must set `basePath` from `BASE_PATH`)
420	  3. other `scripts.dev` → `npm run dev`; else `scripts.start` → `npm start`
421	  4. `index.html` in project root (or `dist/`, `build/`, `public/`, `out/`) → **built-in static server**
422	     (zero-dep, in the claudebox process) serving that dir under `/preview/<slug>/` (and also without
423	     the prefix, for strip-prefix proxies), path-traversal safe, `Cache-Control: no-cache`.
424	* Stop: SIGTERM to the group, SIGKILL after 3 s; then any other listener on that port is killed too.
425	* Vite's host check: requests are accepted for `Host: claudebox[:port]`, localhost and IPs.
426	  The app's preview proxy should therefore send `Host: claudebox:<port>` (http-proxy `changeOrigin: true`)
427	  — or the project's vite config must set `server.allowedHosts`.

429	## Environment variables
430	
431	| Variable | Default | Purpose |
432	|---|---|---|
433	| `CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY` | — | Bearer token for `/v2/*` (and `/v1/*` if set). Required. |
434	| `CLAUDEBOX_ALLOW_NO_AUTH` | `0` | `1` = allow `/v2/*` without a key (dev only). |
435	| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | — | Default Claude auth (optional; per-run `authToken` overrides). |
436	| `PORT` | `3000` | API port. |
437	| `MAX_CONCURRENT` | `4` | Max simultaneous runs (and legacy `/prompt` requests). |
438	| `PROJECTS_DIR` | `/workspace/projects` | Project root (cwd = `<dir>/<slug>`). |
439	| `UPLOADS_DIR` | `/workspace/uploads` | Allowed attachment root (mount read-only). |
440	| `PREVIEW_PORT_MIN` / `PREVIEW_PORT_MAX` | `4100` / `4199` | Allowed preview ports. |
441	| `PREVIEW_ALLOWED_HOST` | `claudebox` | Passed to vite via `__VITE_ADDITIONAL_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS`. |

## 8. Sub-projects, git branches, checkpoints, topics (v4)
- **Sub-projects**: `projects.parent_id` (max depth 2). A child is a full project (own dir/slug/port/chats).
  Effective role = max(own membership, membership on the parent); admins see all. `POST /api/projects {parentId}`
  (editor on parent), `PATCH /api/projects/:id {parentId|null}` (owner), `DELETE /api/projects/:id` → 409 `has_children`
  unless `?cascade=1`. Slugs may not contain `--`.
- **Git**: every project dir is a git repo (init or adopt on startup/first use; existing repo's current branch = main;
  `.gitignore` gets node_modules, dist, .next, .venv, __pycache__, .DS_Store). All git runs in claudebox
  (`POST /v2/git/<op>`, see claudebox/PROTOCOL.md) because worktree metadata holds absolute paths that must be the
  paths Claude sees (`/workspace/projects/...`); the app image has no git.
- **Branches** = worktrees at `projects/.branches/<slug>/<dir>` (`dir` = name with `/`→`_`, stable across renames),
  table `branches` (status active|merged|discarded, own `preview_port` from 4100-4199). Everything branch-scoped takes
  `?branch=<name>`: files, preview, conversations (`conversations.branch`, NULL = main), runs (`worktree` → cwd).
  Preview: `/preview/<slug>--<dir>/` (BASE_PATH likewise; proxy splits at the last `--`).
  `GET/POST /api/projects/:id/branches`, `PATCH|DELETE /api/projects/:id/branches/:name` (rename | discard),
  `GET .../branches/:name/diff`, `GET .../branches/:name/diff/file?path=`, `POST .../branches/:name/merge {close}` →
  `{ok, sha}` or `{ok:false, conflicts, resolvePrompt}` (main untouched). Closing a branch moves its chats to main.
- **Checkpoints**: pending edits are committed right before a run ("nxeon: edits before run"), and every successful run
  is committed as `nxeon: <first 60 chars of prompt>` (`runs.commit_sha`). `GET /api/projects/:id/history?branch=`,
  `POST /api/projects/:id/checkpoint?branch=`, `POST /api/runs/:id/undo` / `POST /api/projects/:id/history/:sha/revert`
  (`git revert --no-edit`, `runs.undo_sha`).
- **Topics**: `topics(id, project_id, name, color, sort)`, `conversations.topic_id` (ON DELETE SET NULL).
  `GET/POST /api/projects/:id/topics`, `PATCH/DELETE /api/topics/:id`, `PATCH /api/conversations/:id {topicId}`.
- **Graph**: `GET /api/projects/graph?satellites=1` adds `kind: 'branch'|'topic'` nodes (`parentId`); projects carry
  `kind: 'project'|'subproject'` + `parentId`; links `child|branch|topic`. WS: `sub_project {branch}` watches a worktree;
  `file_change|preview_status|run_status|graph_pulse` carry `branch`; `project_changed {what}` signals refetches.
EOF
echo ok

input.message:
## Report: sub-projects, git branches and checkpoints, topics, Nexus satellites

All three features are built and deployed (app + claudebox). Every quality gate passes. The owner's goonies-fanpage project was adopted into git without losing anything, and its preview is running again.

### Design decisions
- **Where git runs.** All git operations go through new claudebox endpoints, `POST /v2/git/<op>` (in `claudebox/lib/git.js`). I chose this over adding git to `Dockerfile.app` for three reasons:
  - A git worktree records absolute paths. Those must be `/workspace/projects/...`, which is what Claude sees, or Claude's own git commands would break inside the worktree.
  - claudebox already has git and owns the files as uid 1000.
  - Operations are serialized per repository in one place.
  - Hooks are disabled for these calls, and every repo gets user "Nxeon" / nxeon@workspace.local.
- **Repo setup.** Each project is initialized or adopted at app startup and lazily on first use. An existing `.git` is adopted, and its current branch becomes "main". The `.gitignore` gets the requested entries.
  - Writing into `.git` through the file API is blocked.
- **Branches.**
  - Each branch is a worktree at `projects/.branches/<slug>/<dir>`; `<dir>` is the name with `/` turned into `_`.
  - The dir stays fixed when a branch is renamed, so Claude's `--resume` sessions and the preview URL don't change.
  - Branch names: lowercase letters, digits, single `-` and `/`, up to 40 characters.
  - Each active branch gets its own preview port from 4100-4199.
- **Preview URLs.** Branch previews live at `/preview/<slug>--<dir>/`. New project slugs may not contain `--`. The proxy tries the exact slug first, then splits at the last `--`. `BASE_PATH`, the static prefix, Vite's `--base` and the system prompt all use this key.
- **Permissions.**
  - A sub-project's effective role is max(own role, role on the parent), applied everywhere project access is checked, including WS, the preview proxy and listings. Admins see everything.
  - All branch, checkpoint, undo and topic changes need editor. Viewers are read-only.
  - Re-parenting a project needs owner.
  - Deleting a parent that has children returns 409 `has_children` unless `?cascade=1` is passed.
- **Checkpoints.**
  - After every successful run, all changes in that checkout are committed as `nxeon: <first 60 chars of prompt>`, and the sha goes on `runs.commit_sha`.
  - I added one thing beyond the brief: pending editor edits are committed just before a run starts ("nxeon: edits before run"). Without this, "Undo this run" would also wipe the user's own edits; the tests caught that.
  - Undo is `git revert --no-edit` and records `runs.undo_sha`. If the revert conflicts it is aborted and the conflicting files are reported.
- **Merge.** Both sides are checkpointed, then `git merge-tree` does a dry run, then `merge --no-ff` runs. On conflict, main is never touched; the API returns `{ok:false, conflicts, resolvePrompt}` and the UI's "Ask Claude to resolve" switches to the branch and sends that prompt.
  - Closing a branch (after merge, or discard) moves its chats to main with a fresh Claude session.
- **Nexus.**
  - Sub-projects, branches (diamond glyphs) and topics (tiny dots) orbit their owner; they are not part of the force simulation.
  - They stay folded in by default and fan out with animation on hover (with a short hold), when zoomed past 1.35× the fitted zoom, or via a toggle (`S` key or button, remembered).
  - Pulses travel from the branch or sub-project along its strand.
  - With more than 140 satellites, drawing is simplified and batched.
- **Changes to the shared files the other agent may edit** are small:
  - `server/src/runs.ts`: `buildSystemPrompt` takes an optional 4th `branch` argument (2 prompt lines added), plus the checkpoint hook and branch-aware preview auto-start.
  - `claudebox/lib/runs.js`: `worktree` option (sets cwd and the preview key).

### Endpoints
- Branches:
  - `GET/POST /api/projects/:id/branches`
  - `PATCH/DELETE /api/projects/:id/branches/:name` (rename / discard)
  - `GET .../branches/:name/diff` and `.../diff/file?path=`
  - `POST .../branches/:name/merge {close}`
- History and undo:
  - `GET /api/projects/:id/history?branch=`
  - `POST /api/projects/:id/checkpoint?branch=`
  - `POST /api/projects/:id/history/:sha/revert`
  - `POST /api/runs/:id/undo`
- Topics: `GET/POST /api/projects/:id/topics`, `PATCH/DELETE /api/topics/:id`, and `PATCH /api/conversations/:id {topicId}`.
- `?branch=` now works on all files, preview and conversations routes. Projects accept `parentId` on create and patch.
- `GET /api/projects/graph?satellites=1` adds branch and topic nodes. Project nodes now carry `kind`/`parentId`; without the parameter the response keeps the old shape.
- WS: `sub_project {branch}` watches a branch worktree. `file_change`, `preview_status`, `run_status` and `graph_pulse` carry `branch`. A new `project_changed` message tells clients to refetch. Both `protocol.ts` copies are identical.
- Documented in `claudebox/PROTOCOL.md` (Git section) and `SPEC.md` §8.

### Migration v4
- `projects`: `parent_id`, `git_main`.
- New tables: `branches`, `topics`.
- `conversations`: `branch`, `topic_id`.
- `runs`: `branch`, `commit_sha`, `undo_sha`.
- Dry-run on a copy of the production DB succeeded before deploying.

### Verification
- **Test suites:**

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| Server `npm test` | 64/64 pass |
| Server typecheck | clean |
| claudebox `npm test` | 32/32 pass |
| Web `tsc --noEmit`, `vite build`, reducer tests (8/8) | pass |

  - New tests: `server/test/branches.test.ts` covers permission inheritance, re-parenting and cascade, the full branch lifecycle (create, edit, diff, merge, conflict, discard, rename), branch preview proxying, branch WS file watching, checkpoint and undo of a run, topics CRUD and the graph shape.
  - `claudebox/test/git.test.js` runs the git layer against real git.
  - The fake claudebox used by the server tests runs the real `git.js`.
- **Production, after backups and an idle check:**
  - goonies-fanpage was set up as a repo (one "initial snapshot" commit, clean status, files intact).
  - Its preview was restarted and serves through the proxy.
  - With throwaway projects I checked: branch and main previews at their separate URLs, diff, merge, topics and graph satellites.
  - One real haiku run (thinking off, $0.022) ran in the branch worktree, was checkpointed, and was undone (the file it created was removed).
- **Browser checks:** checked in Playwright and I looked at every screenshot; layout issues found were fixed (branch labels covering their project, the zoom threshold).
  - The only requests to outside hosts were Google Fonts loaded by the user's own goonies preview page.
- **Performance:** with a synthetic 50-project web plus about 330 satellites, the JS draw cost is about 3.6 ms per frame, the same as without satellites. Headless Chromium on this VPS has no GPU and reaches 35–42 fps with satellites against about 45 without, so I could not confirm 60 fps; with a real GPU it should be well within budget.

### Screenshots
- Local stack with a mock Claude: `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-claude/a5a0e1b8-f10f-4557-a424-37ef9c870766/scratchpad/qa/branches/shots/` — Nexus folded / toggled / zoomed / hover cards, branch switcher, new-branch form, compare view, history, topics, breadcrumbs, merge and conflict dialogs, mobile at 390px.
- Production: `.../qa/branches/shots-prod/`.

### Caveats
- **Throwaway projects not deleted.** "QA Branches Lab" and its child "QA Child" are still in production: the owner started their own run ("do research on nxeon.cloud") in one of their chats. To remove them: `DELETE /api/projects/b0fd4d6e-fa24-40f1-be8f-a57d60ba796d?cascade=1`.
- **Shared port pool.** Projects and active branches share the 100 preview ports, so heavy branching can hit `no_ports`.
- **Mixed checkpoints.** Two runs at the same time in the same checkout land their changes in each other's checkpoints.
- **Branch previews need an install.** Worktrees have no `node_modules`, so the first preview of an npm project on a branch runs `npm install`.
- **Graph counts can lag.** Branch counts in the graph are cached and refreshed in the background about once a minute.
- **Debug hooks.** `window.__nxWs`, `__nxProbe` and `__nxEngine` exist only when `localStorage.nxDebug === '1'`.
- **Backups.**
  - `data/db/nxeon-pre-branches-1790966321.db` (+ `-wal`)
  - `data/db/nxeon-pre-branches-consistent.db`
  - `data/backups/projects-pre-branches-1790966321.tgz`
- The local QA stack is stopped. Nothing is committed.

### Files to commit
- **claudebox:** `lib/git.js` (new), `lib/preview.js`, `lib/runs.js`, `server.js`, `PROTOCOL.md`, `test/git.test.js` (new), `test/v2.test.js`.
- **server:** `src/db.ts`, `auth.ts`, `claudebox.ts`, `config.ts`, `dto.ts`, `hub.ts`, `watchers.ts`, `app.ts`, `runs.ts`, `lib/branches.ts` (new), `routes/branches.ts` (new), `routes/topics.ts` (new), `routes/projects.ts`, `conversations.ts`, `files.ts`, `preview.ts`, `previewProxy.ts`, `ws.ts`, `shared/protocol.ts`; tests `helpers.ts`, `projects.test.ts`, `branches.test.ts` (new).
- **web:** `shared/protocol.ts`, `lib/types.ts`, `lib/ws.ts`, `stores/ui.ts`, `stores/projects.ts`, `features/nexus/{engine.ts, NexusPage.tsx, NewProjectModal.tsx}`, `features/workspace/{store.ts, WorkspacePage.tsx, LeftRail.tsx, CodePane.tsx, PreviewPane.tsx, monacoSetup.ts, BranchBar.tsx (new), CompareView.tsx (new)}`.
- `SPEC.md`.

### Caveats
- **Throwaway projects not deleted.** "QA Branches Lab" and its child "QA Child" are still in production: the owner started their own run ("do research on nxeon.cloud") in one of their chats. To remove them: `DELETE /api/projects/b0fd4d6e-fa24-40f1-be8f-a57d60ba796d?cascade=1`.
- **Shared port pool.** Projects and active branches share the 100 preview ports, so heavy branching can hit `no_ports`.
- **Mixed checkpoints.** Two runs at the same time in the same checkout land their changes in each other's checkpoints.
- **Branch previews need an install.** Worktrees have no `node_modules`, so the first preview of an npm project on a branch runs `npm install`.
- **Graph counts can lag.** Branch counts in the graph are cached and refreshed in the background about once a minute.
